title: Mobile and Wi-Fi in practice
intro: Keep your phone and connection safe. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Message from Deals group
decisions.prompt: Someone shared a free app file in a group. What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: Deals group
body: FotoRedaktor Plus Pro costs money in the store, get it free here: fotoredaktor-pro.test/app.apk

decisions.explain: Install apps only from your phone's official store.

decisions.title: kafe-nargiz-wifi.test
decisions.prompt: The Wi-Fi page wants your work password. What do you do on this page?
decisions.explain: A Wi-Fi page asking for your work password is fake. Forget the network.

decisions.title: Work phone
decisions.prompt: The find service shows the phone on the map. What do you do?

artifact.title: Work phone
body: Last seen: Narimanov district, 5 minutes ago.

decisions.explain: Locking takes a minute and keeps strangers out of the phone.

decisions.title: Maps asks for access
decisions.explain: A map needs your location to guide you. Allowing it only while in use is a smart choice.

decisions.title: Message from +994 55 000 11 22

body: SahilBank has a new app. Download it here: sahilbank-app.test/SahilBank.apk

decisions.explain: A bank app is in the official store. An install file sent by link may be harmful.
